question.text: If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1,2</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>p</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2,8</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>α</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>α</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> are ordered triplet pair of the form <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>z</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> which satisfy all the equations <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mi>a</mi></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>y</mi><mi>b</mi></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>z</mi><mi>c</mi></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mi>b</mi></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>y</mi><mi>c</mi></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>z</mi><mi>a</mi></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mi>c</mi></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>y</mi><mi>a</mi></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>z</mi><mi>b</mi></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the sum of all the values of <math><mi>α</mi></math> is equal to (where, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>c</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mi>a</mi><mo>≠</mo></math><math><mn>0</mn></math>)

solution.text:
System of equation has more than one solution
∆=1a1b1c1b1c1a1c1a1b=0⇒1a=1b=1c⇒a=b=c
⇒ all three equations are x+y+z=a
Now, 2,8,-6 satisfy this equation
2+8-6=a⇒a=4
1,2,p also satisfy this equation
⇒1+2+p=4⇒p=1
α2-2α,p,1 also satisfy this equation
⇒α2-2α+1+1=4⇒α2-2α-2=0
Sum of the values of α =2
